mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member) AS member_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM board) AS board_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inquiry WHERE status = 'PENDING') AS pending_inquiry_count
SELECT member_id, nickname, email, member_role, member_status, create_at, DATE_FORMAT(create_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS create_at_str FROM member ORDER BY create_at DESC, member_id ASC LIMIT 200

SELECT b.board_id, b.member_id, COALESCE(m.nickname, '탈퇴한 회원') AS nickname, b.category, b.title, b.content, b.is_hidden AS hidden, b.create_at, DATE_FORMAT(b.create_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS create_at_str FROM board b LEFT JOIN member m ON m.member_id = b.member_id ORDER BY b.create_at DESC, b.board_id DESC LIMIT 200

SELECT c.comment_id, c.board_id, c.member_id, COALESCE(m.nickname, '탈퇴한 회원') AS nickname, c.content, c.is_hidden AS hidden, c.create_at, DATE_FORMAT(c.create_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS create_at_str FROM board_comment c LEFT JOIN member m ON m.member_id = c.member_id ORDER BY c.create_at DESC, c.comment_id DESC LIMIT 200
mapper.update: UPDATE inquiry SET status = 'COMPLETED', answered_by = COALESCE(answered_by, #{adminId}), answered_at = COALESCE(answered_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) WHERE inquiry_id = #{inquiryId} AND status = 'ANSWERED'
mapper.select: SELECT stock_code, stock_name, current_price FROM stock ORDER BY stock_name ASC, stock_code ASC LIMIT 300
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stock (stock_code, stock_name, current_price) VALUES (#{stockCode}, #{stockName}, #{currentPrice})
mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM holding WHERE stock_code = #{stockCode}) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trade WHERE stock_code = #{stockCode})
SELECT term_id, term, definition, category FROM glossary ORDER BY category ASC, term ASC LIMIT 500
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO glossary (term, definition, category) VALUES (#{term}, #{definition}, #{category})
mapper.select: SELECT l.log_id, l.admin_id, COALESCE(m.nickname, '탈퇴한 관리자') AS admin_nickname, l.action_type, l.target_type, l.target_id, l.detail, l.create_at, DATE_FORMAT(l.create_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS create_at_str FROM admin_log l LEFT JOIN member m ON m.member_id = l.admin_id ORDER BY l.create_at DESC, l.log_id DESC LIMIT 200
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO admin_log ( admin_id, action_type, target_type, target_id, detail ) VALUES ( #{adminId}, #{actionType}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{detail} )
